caption:
Never stress over a leave email again 😌 Copy this prompt, change the details, done in 10 seconds.

Comment "PROMPT" for 10 more office prompts 📩

#aiprompts #chatgpt #officelife #emailtips #worksmarter #corporatelife #aihacks #smartwork

scenes.title: Copy this prompt
scenes.text: Write a short, polite leave request email to my manager for [dates]. Reason: [reason]. Mention my work is covered by [colleague] and I'll be reachable for urgent issues. Professional but warm tone.

scenes.title: AI's version:
scenes.text: Hi Priya, I'd like to request leave from 2-4 Dec for a family function. Rahul will cover my tasks, and I'll be reachable for anything urgent. Thank you!
